$comment: Source of truth for .coderails/workflow.config.yaml. status: enforced_by_code | read_by_prose_only | unused. control:true marks a safety switch whose on_value an empty config must resolve to; blocked_on names the owner of any control that is not yet ON by default. Generated key table in docs/REFERENCE.md is rendered from this file (scripts/lib/config_schema_docs.py).

project.description: The `/coderails:init` command writes the project name. Only command instructions read this value.

wiki_path.description: LLM wiki vault directory (relative to the project dir, or absolute). null disables the wiki gate and the wiki-debt merge gate.

wiki_stale_days.description: The number of days before a wiki page becomes a staleness candidate. The `scripts/wiki_lint.py stale` command reads it. Without comparable repo sources, the command uses only the date to mark a candidate stale.

wiki_supervision.description: The wiki-ingest mode is `discuss` or `autonomous`. The `discuss` mode pauses before a write.

wiki_git_worktree.description: Use `true` for the PR workflow for wiki commits. Use `false` to commit directly to the vault.

wiki_git_bypass_flag.description: Environment setting for wiki PR creation and merge, for example `BYPASS_REVIEW=1`.

wiki_git_pull_path.description: Source repo pulled after a wiki PR merges.

wiki_debt_epoch_pr.description: First PR number that the wiki-ingest debt merge gate checks. Without the key, the gate is off. It refuses an empty value or `null`.

worktree_script.description: Project script that makes a worktree.

jira.description: Jira settings: `project`, `epic`, `component_name`, `component_id`, `epic_field`, `points_field`, `fix_version`, `mcp_namespace`, and `transitions`. The schema does not check the types of nested keys.

engineering_principles_paths.description: Glob patterns that start the engineering-principles pre-flight in `/coderails:push`.

engineering_principles_skill.description: The slash command that the pre-flight runs. The value `null` skips it.

sandbox_workers.description: The default is ON. Claude `graph_dispatch.plan()` reports `sandboxed` or `in-process-fallback:<reason>` for U3 nodes. While ON, Codex refuses native U3 spawns. Use the OAuth graph driver and its sealed worker records. Output from a standalone worker cannot complete a graph node. OFF explicitly permits use of the parent sandbox behavior.

subagent_identity_gate.description: The default `on` denies an untyped Bash subagent in a graph-bound Claude session. Use `off` to disable that hook.

action_authority.description: The default `enforce` makes signed receipts mandatory for guarded merges and pushes. Use `advisory` for warnings or `off` to disable this receipt gate. The check refuses an incorrect configuration.

diff_manifest.description: Diff-manifest publication gate for `push.py`, `merge.py`, and direct-merge hooks. The default `enforce` uses the policy in the plugin. Strict config readers refuse incorrect values.

review_passes.description: The publication gate checks the reviewer rules in `policy/review_policy.json`. The default is `enforce`. The value `off` skips the check. All other values apply it.

eval_level.description: The publication gate checks derived eval level and suite integrity with `policy/surface_policy.json`. The default is `enforce`. The value `off` skips the check. All other values apply it.

diff_manifest_policy.description: Path to the diff-manifest policy JSON. If there is no key or its value is `null`, the reader uses `policy/diff-policy.default.json`.

enabled.description: After the server rule is active, `true` makes the `integrity-review` status from `github-actions[bot]` mandatory on the current PR head.

machine_user.description: Deprecated. If `enabled` is not `true`, local checks accept only the nonempty legacy login as the status author.

require_signatures.description: The default `true` makes eval artifact signatures mandatory. The signer makes a local key on first use. It refuses to sign without `ssh-keygen`. Use `false` to opt out.

backend.description: The default `muninn` uses Muninn as the authoritative typed-memory store. If Muninn is unavailable or refuses an operation, the adapter gives a cause code. Use `off` to disable typed memory. The adapter logs `memory_backend_off` and does not read or write Markdown. It refuses other values with `memory_backend_invalid`.
